is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports Ace-1 G119S (G280S) and Ace-1 duplication (CNV).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (SS, GS, GG) for An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. across 18 sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 18 sites in southern Ghana.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The paper provides data for 18 specific study sites in southern Ghana (Figure 1, Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larvae were collected from March to mid-August 2011.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports original field collections from 2011.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts are provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the Ace-1 G119S mutation and Ace-1 duplication in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii populations across 18 sites in southern Ghana. It found a strong association between the G119S mutation and resistance to bendiocarb and fenitrothion, and detected Ace-1 copy number variation.
